about.title: A forwarder that shows its working
about.p1: ARG Logistics is a Malaysian freight forwarder based in Puchong, Selangor. We handle sea, air and land shipments for exporters and importers across Malaysia — from first-time online sellers to established manufacturers.
about.p2: Unlike brokers who call carriers for every quote, our pricing engine calculates your estimate instantly from real distance, fuel and seasonal factors. You see the breakdown before you commit — in Ringgit, not guesswork.

pricing.title: Transparent MYR pricing
pricing.desc: Every estimate itemised — base freight, fuel, lane and season factors, plus our service fee.

instant.title: Instant online estimates
instant.desc: No waiting on callbacks. Get a number in seconds, then lock it with our team.

owner.title: Owner-operated care
owner.desc: You deal directly with the people moving your cargo, not a call centre.

customs.title: In-house customs team
customs.desc: Licensed brokers clear your goods without third-party handoffs or delays.

door.title: True door-to-door
door.desc: We collect from your factory or home and deliver to the consignee's door.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp-first support
whatsapp.desc: One message reaches a real coordinator — replies within working hours, usually minutes.

promise.title: Our promise
promise.desc: If we cannot beat a comparable written quote on the same service level, we will tell you honestly — and often still find a way to save you money on routing or packaging.

contact.title: Talk to a real coordinator
contact.subtitle: Call, email or WhatsApp — you will reach our Puchong office directly during working hours.
contact.whatsappMessage: Hello ARG Logistics, I would like to ask about a shipment.

cta.title: Prefer to chat right away?
cta.desc: WhatsApp us your cargo details — origin, destination, weight and dimensions — for a fast reply.

footer.blurb: Sea, air and land freight from Malaysia to the world — with instant transparent pricing and owner-operated service.
